name: Plo Koon's Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor
wookieepedia_title: Plo Koon's Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends
description: Unlike many other Jedi in 19 BBY, Plo Koon reverted to flying a standard Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor. This starfighter had a customized paint job similar to that of Plo's Blade of Dorin and Anakin Skywalker's Azure Angel, marking the ship with distinctive blue and white stripes.
